concepts.title: Balanced cel comic
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one finished wide 16:9 2D side-view gameplay concept for Supa Dude, a sunny playful suburban superhero runner.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the exact MC identity reference. Image 2 shows the previous art which is TOO DETAILED. Image 3 shows the previous art which is TOO SIMPLE. Create a NEW image at a deliberately intermediate detail level between images 2 and 3. Do not duplicate either background. Preserve image 1's character: oversized white round head, tiny black oval eyes, simple smiling curved mouth, thin black stick-line torso and limbs with rounded ends, small flowing RED cape at neck. ONE MC only, facing right with face visible. No suit, clothes, shoes, gloves, chest emblem, hair, fingers or human anatomy.
STYLE TARGET: professional, approachable cartoon COMIC GAME ART with MEDIUM DETAIL. Simple readable silhouettes plus a few purposeful interior details. Confident bold black outer contours and thinner interior lines, flat color plus ONE clean cel-shadow per object, restrained highlights. Houses have roof trim, window frames and a porch or garage, but NO individual shingles, bricks, siding texture, hatching or dense little ornaments. Trees have 3–5 broad foliage clumps and one shadow color, NOT individual leaves or plain single cloud blobs. Cars have window division, door seam, handle, lights and simple hubcaps, NOT a featureless icon and NOT realistic mechanical rendering. Fences may have visible slats but not wood grain. A few grass tufts only. No paper grain, noise, halftone, photorealism, painterly texture or elaborate gradients.
CAMERA: fixed side elevation, continuous horizontal sidewalk as play surface, asphalt road one curb below, house facades behind, blue sky with a few simple clouds. Not isometric or behind-the-runner; no road vanishing into distance. Traffic side profile points left toward the MC. Same-plane objects have consistent scale. MC roughly 20 percent image height, near left third. Keep open air around the hero, only two main houses, one short fence section, a few trees and 3–4 useful props. Lighter background outlines, strongest contour on MC, car and target. Sunny upper-left light, warm cream, sky blue, green lawns, red cape. Moderate richness without clutter, distinctly more designed than the sparse preschool-like version, distinctly simpler than the textured illustration.
No text, logos, labels, watermarks, UI, panels or collage. No ducking. One coherent game scene.
Variation 7: crisp rounded cel-comic drawing, bright fresh palette. MC jumping over sidewalk, black line legs expressively bent, cape trailing left. A short orange flame with pale core from his leading arm hits a rounded bush ahead in a small playful puff. A red compact car approaches from right on lower road, fully readable side profile with simple glass highlight, clean doors and tires. Two cream houses with warm coral pitched roofs and blue window frames; one has a simple porch. Low white fence, grouped foliage, gray trash can and mailbox. Big color shapes, a few meaningful details, crisp shadows. Comfortable middle between a basic flat icon scene and richly textured narrative illustration.

concepts.title: Balanced cel comic
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
EDIT IMAGE 1, the simple side-view game scene. Image 2 is the MC identity reference. The goal is a MODERATE-detail version of image 1: just ONE SMALL STEP richer than its basic flat shapes, halfway to a detailed cartoon illustration. Preserve image 1's airy composition, big sky, sparse object count, basic house shapes, tree silhouettes, simple black stick figure with white smiling round head and red cape, continuous sidewalk and lower road. Preserve wide landscape format, sunny mood, side elevation and hero facing right.
Make ONLY these controlled detail additions: add thin trim around windows, one center window divider, a plain doorstep and a single inset panel on house door. Add a door outline, handle, small mirror, headlight and simple wheel hubs on the car. Add ONE broad flat shadow patch inside each tree or bush, ONE flat shadow on house wall and car lower body. Add a few fence slats in a SHORT section only if mentioned below. That's the whole level of richness.
Keep tree crowns as three or four broad lobes, not intricate leaf clusters. Keep car rounded and cartoon-like, not a realistic vehicle. Keep buildings as simple house silhouettes, not elaborate porch or garage architecture. NO roof shingles, grass tufts, leaf marks, bark, siding lines, brickwork, flowerbeds, garden clutter, road texture, cracks, hatching, halftone, painterly shading, gradients or realistic reflections. Most surfaces stay broad solid color. Bold rounded contours with thinner sparse detail lines. No character redesign, costume or new characters. No UI, words, watermarks, text or panels.
Keep the reference's red car at right, cream houses with coral roofs, gray trashcan at left and central green bush. MC is in an expressive small jump casting a short orange fire puff into bush, not a long screen-filling beam. Simple pale core in flame. Friendly clean cel cartoon, basic scene enriched only with the limited details above.
